failure_classification: Gate010 implementation failure before scientific test: the official packed microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T configuration declares linear_class=autobitlinear and quantization_mode=offline, while Gate010 searched only for transformers.integrations.bitnet.BitLinear instances. The failed run therefore cannot adjudicate the adaptive-A4 hypothesis.
repair: Target the actual offline transformers.integrations.bitnet.AutoBitLinear modules and substitute activation quantization at the same post-module-RMSNorm location where AutoBitLinear.forward calls ActQuant.apply(input). Leave unpacked/fixed ternary weights, bias handling, weight_scale, datasets, calibration, A4 definitions, codebook construction, bootstrap seeds, and pass/fail thresholds unchanged.
pass_rule: On each corpus adaptive mean NLL must be lower than dynamic-absmax A4, paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of adaptive-minus-dynamic must be <0, and adaptive NLL must be <= native A8 NLL +0.50; frozen data hashes must match.
failure_rule: If Gate010R executes the intended AutoBitLinear-site experiment and fails the frozen pass rule, stop the adaptive-A4 method lane. Gate011 remains forbidden unless Gate010R passes.
interpretation_boundary: This repair changes implementation compatibility only. It does not reopen Gate009 shape-gain, alter novelty claims, tune on evaluation loss, or create a new scientific hypothesis.
